$comment: The file rules of NL avatar packs. The skill's checker (pack.ts) and the app (crates/nl-assets) both read this file, so that a pack the checker accepts is a pack the app accepts. Code (.html, .js, .mjs, .css, .wasm, .svg) is allowed for a code rendition's page (user decision, 2026-11-19): NL runs it only in a sandboxed frame that reaches nothing but the pack's own files, and never anywhere else.
